influences.name: Kakraba Lobi
influences.context: A pivotal collaboration occurred in 1990 with Ghanaian gyil (xylophone) master Kakraba Lobi, resulting in the album African Percussion Meeting, which juxtaposed Japanese marimba techniques against West African polyrhythms in improvisational duets emphasizing timbre and repetition

influences.name: Tadashi Suzuki
influences.context: Domestically, Takada composed original scores and performed live for theater productions directed by Tadashi Suzuki, beginning in the mid-1980s and continuing through the 1990s with his Suzuki Company of Toga; these works adapted her repetitive motifs to dramatic pacing, influencing her shift toward more performative, site-specific minimalism
